description: Defines a templated expiring cache class with customizable expiration and eviction policies, including internal iterator and cache management methods.

classes.name: NoopEvictionHandler
classes.description: A default eviction handler that performs no action on eviction.

classes.name: ExpiringCache
classes.description: A cache that stores entries with explicit expiration policies, supporting customizable expiration comparison and eviction handling.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to the value associated with a key if it is valid at the given time.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Inserts or updates an entry with a specified expiration time.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: max_entries
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of entries allowed in the cache.

methods.name: Compact
methods.description: Removes expired or excess entries to maintain cache size constraints.

methods.name: Evict
methods.description: Removes a specific entry from the cache, invoking the eviction handler.
